messages.text: @AmazonHelp Someone made an unauthorized purchase on my account using my stored credit card!
@cust_8 We take security very seriously! Please immediately DM us your email and secure your account by changing your password.
@AmazonHelp I changed password. Please cancel that order and secure the account.
@cust_8 Fraud team has been alerted, unauthorized transaction blocked, and account secured.
@AmazonHelp My package says delivered but I checked my porch and mailbox and nothing is there.
@cust_6 Please allow 24 hours as carriers sometimes scan early. If still missing, DM us your order details for assistance.
@AmazonHelp Still missing after checking with neighbors. Please help.
@cust_6 Thank you for confirming. We have initiated a replacement order for you at no additional charge.
@AmazonHelp I cannot log into my account. It says password incorrect even though I reset it.
@cust_3 Sorry for the hassle! Try clearing browser cache or resetting password via our account recovery link: amazon.com/help
@AmazonHelp Your customer support team was super helpful today resolving my issue. Thank you!
@cust_9 You are very welcome! We are always happy to help. Have a wonderful day!
@AmazonHelp I received the wrong item in my package. I ordered shoes but got a kitchen blender.
@cust_13 We apologize for the mix up! DM us your order number so we can send the correct item right away.
@AmazonHelp DM sent with order number 114-009988-12345.
@cust_13 Correct item dispatched! Return label for blender has been sent to your email.
@AmazonHelp I want to cancel order 408-1122334-998877 before it ships.
@cust_7 You can cancel unshipped items under Your Orders on our website, or DM us if you need us to process it for you.
@AmazonHelp DM sent with confirmation request.
@cust_7 Order 408-1122334-998877 has been successfully cancelled and any hold on your card released.
@AmazonHelp I was billed for a gift card that I never received or purchased.
@cust_15 Security alert! DM us your email and account details immediately so our payments security team can audit this charge.
@AmazonHelp Sent DM with payment transaction ID.
@cust_15 Transaction cancelled, refund initiated, and security verification required.
@AmazonHelp Received a broken ceramic vase in my package today! The box was completely damaged.
@cust_4 That is terrible to hear! Please DM us your order ID and a photo of the damaged item so we can arrange a free replacement.
@AmazonHelp Just sent the order ID and image link in DM.
@cust_4 Replacement order has been placed! You will receive a tracking link shortly.
